brief:
A documentary about Gaza has sparked backlash in Israel, with critics refusing to engage with its content, according to Al Jazeera English. The resistance reflects what observers describe as a broader reluctance to confront the documented reality of events in Gaza.

The refusal to view or discuss the film points to deeper tensions within Israeli society over accountability and acknowledgment of the conflict's humanitarian toll.
dek: The backlash against the Gaza documentary is part of a broader refusal to confront the reality of the genocide.
title: Israel resists Gaza documentary amid genocide accusations
